d:
Serafina is a popular live streamer and influencer who has tens of thousands of followers. Looking at her it is easy to understand why. Everything was going well for her until the night a stalker broke into her apartment and then choked her to death before having his way with her body. He then made up her face before leaving.

Serafina's last home of survival failed when her boyfriend arrived too late to save her despite frantic CPR attempts. It was little comfort to her that the mortician did a wonderful job restoring her to her full beauty for her open casket funeral.
